name: Ray-marching reference (min-max octree accelerated)
aliases: Empty Space Skipping with Min/Max Cells
Interactive Isosurface Ray Tracing of Large Octree Volumes
definition: Accelerated direct isosurface visualization technique using a min-max octree for empty space skipping, serving as a performance baseline.
summary: This accelerated direct isosurface visualization technique uses a min-max octree to skip empty space during ray marching, offering negligible memory overhead and broad applicability to scalar volumes.
